about: Round 730. Every row of public.ballon_dor, read by SELECT on 2026-09-30 (76 rows: 69 Men and 7 Women, rank 1 only, points and nationality NULL on every row), checked field by field against the co-organiser's own list (uefa.com, UEFA has co-organised the Ballon d'Or with Groupe Amaury, owner of France Football, since 2024) and at least one independent source on another host. Wikipedia is never a source here. Winner, year, rank and club were right on all 76 rows, so nothing is corrected; nationality was NULL on all 76 and the migration fills it. club is the club at the time of the award, as the official list gives it. nationality is the nation the player represented at the time of the award, written the way the site's other tables write it (Czech Republic, United States). points stays NULL: no reader shows it and nothing here verifies it. scripts/simBallonDor.mjs holds the migration's end state to this record.

definitions.year: The year of the ceremony (2024 is the award for 2023-24, Rodri).
definitions.club: The club at the time of the award, as the official list gives it.
definitions.nationality: The nation the player represented at the time of the award, in the site's spelling.
